sources.title: Equilibrium singular dividend control under ambiguity aggregation of heterogeneous discount rates
sources.snippet: This paper studies a singular dividend control problem for a firm with heterogeneous shareholders whose discount rates follow a given distribution. The central planner aggregates expected discounted payoffs using an ambiguity aggregation function $phi$, which captures shareholder heterogeneity and ambiguity attitudes but also leads to time inconsistency.
